## Required

- [ ] Links an accepted issue (`Closes #N`), or is a very small, self-contained fix
- [ ] The gate is green: `tsc --noEmit`, `biome check .`, `cargo test` and `vitest run` (and the `extension/` tests if I touch it)
- [ ] I tested it by hand and I understand what this PR does (also if an AI wrote it)
- [ ] No new dependencies, or I justify them in the commit
- [ ] One logical change, with tests, no unrelated files or mass formatting
- [ ] Title is a Conventional Commit
